name: Michaela Schütt
headline: SVP, Digitalization Strategy for People & Organization
summary:
My passion for technology started with my very first Game Boy, followed by a Commodore C64. The passion persisted, leading me to study computer science. Throughout my 10 years in management consulting, digital strategies have consistently been a common theme. However, topics around people have been a focus area for me, too. In my roles in People & Organization, I always sought opportunities to leverage modern technologies and use data as a foundation – for finding the right people, bringing them into our company, and aiding in their learning and growth, all at scale.

In my current role I am exploring ways to change the way we leverage digitalization within People & Organization. From thinking IT tools to delivering meaningful and personalized services to our people, at scale. In a time where change happens at the speed of light, the challenges are huge, but opportunities are even bigger.
 
To be successful. I place people and their experiences at the core of my thinking. This is about learning and un-learning as well: If we allow ourselves to see and think “from scratch” and not just build on traditional HR beliefs and existing HR tools, processes and patterns, we can achieve true excellence. If we are brave enough to start over and rethink our ideas, we create the best people experience, attract the best and brightest minds and helping them learn and grow. I’m curious to meet people who share this passion – not just HR experts, but also innovators, start-ups and companies who break away from established patterns of thought and start to create new paths ahead.

With bold innovations and meaningful solutions with impact on our people, customers, partners, society and the environment – we are helping the world move towards a smarter tomorrow. Do you want to create a better tomorrow with us? Explore our opportunities at: https://new.siemens.com/global/en/company/jobs.html

company.description: Siemens AG (Berlin and Munich) is a leading technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, mobility, and healthcare. The company’s purpose is to create technology to transform the everyday, for everyone. By combining the real and the digital worlds, Siemens empowers customers to accelerate their digital and sustainability transformations, making factories more efficient, cities more livable, and transportation more sustainable. A leader in industrial AI, Siemens leverages its deep domain know-how to apply AI – including generative AI – to real-world applications, making AI accessible and impactful for customers across diverse industries. Siemens also owns a majority stake in the publicly listed company Siemens Healthineers, a leading global medical technology provider pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. In fiscal 2025, which ended on September 30, 2025, the Siemens Group generated revenue of €78.9 billion and net income of €10.4 billion. As of September 30, 2025, the company employed around 318,000 people worldwide on the basis of continuing operations.
